subject: English
question_text: Answer the following question to write a paragraph on
stimulus: `Book Fair'. You should write about 250 words. 10 (a) What influence has a book fair made on the general mass? (b) What type of books are available in the fair? (c) What types of stall are found in the fair other than book stalls? (d) When does the fair become crowdy? (e) What types of programmes are arranged in the fair? (f) What does a book far remind a man? (g) How does a book help a man?
